telepy.architectureNote: The device runs an ordinary ssh -R to the gateway built into Telepy. Nothing is opened on the server, and both ends check each other's host key.

work.title: What I built at work

about.title: About
about.lead: The longer version, for people who scrolled past the jokes.
about.contactIntro: Email is the fastest way to reach me. I read everything, and I answer most of it.
about.valhalla: This site has worn a few looks.
about.valhallaBody: Every look since 2015 still works in Valhalla, from the page with a wind map to the terminal that came right before this one. They all show the current content.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Work, education, skills and open-source contributions on one page. It also prints as a compact CV.
experience.skillsIntro: Years of hands-on use, and where you can see it in my projects.

valhalla.title: Valhalla
valhalla.intro: The same content, in every look this site has worn since 2015. Each theme reads the current content, so nothing here is out of date. Only the haircuts are.
valhalla.how: Every theme reads one file, /content/site.json, published with this site. Add a project once and it shows up in all of them without rebuilding any. Each theme’s own code is built once and then left alone.
valhalla.keepers: Tapi and Chiyo keep the place. Click them; they talk.
